name: Symmachean Paladins
headerMeta: Heroic era · Melee Infantry (Sword & Shield) · shields · 235 leadership · T4 · Mastery
pitch: A defensive shielded unit that excels in close formation, with a unique block-drop mechanic that rewards skill through X-and-V canceling. Synergistic heal sustain keeps them in extended fights, but cav and maul-wielding heroes exploit both that weakness and their vulnerable back side.

doctrines.name: Anti-Infantry Doctrine V
doctrines.note: +200 dmg to infantry, +250 block — can swap for LS doctrine if more sustain needed

doctrines.name: Block-Increase Doctrine
doctrines.note: close to mandatory when paired with piercing damage doctrine slots

veterancy.label: Top line
veterancy.body: Average 1.68% heal per second; more offensive nodes; cooldown on bleed — for aggressive positioning into hero pairing synergy.

veterancy.label: Bottom line
veterancy.body: Average 1.2% heal per second; more defensive nodes; more armor; −10% rare-attack damage; +10% defense plus additional block — deliberately defensive, mitigates maul crunching.

battleRole.positioning: Don't charge in unless you have significant front-line support — they stack easily. Charge while in spread formation rather than tight block formation to avoid AoE hero CC lockdown; this results in the unit naturally surrounding the target after landing, a better overall trade-off. Use their healing to disengage and reposition: take aggro, activate the bleed skill, disengage, heal, repeat. {2}
battleRole.formation: Block/shield-wall formation (F2) useful for both charging in and holding while attacking; spread formation (F1) for low-threat vs high-threat CC scenarios. {2}
battleRole.tips: X-and-V cancel: press V immediately after X-move, unit drops block each time you use X — this resets the attack chain but exposes you to more damage, so only do it when free DPS available, not under threat. When facing large enemy numbers, stick to V (basic attack) only — slower kill but unit takes less damage. Cancel heal animation by instantly pressing V after pressing heal (skill 2) — the heal still resolves. {1} Weak Spot: hits on unit's back deal 20% bonus damage {2} (bottom-vet mitigates to ~10%); opponents actively exploit this.

cards.name: Cavalry
cards.why: Can stun-lock the unit to death if not managed; primary live threat {2}

cards.name: Maul-wielding heroes
cards.why: Dismount-stun into follow-up chains; second primary live threat {2}

cards.name: Pikes
cards.why: This unit counters pikes per Amya

matchups.pressure: Pikes are your direct counter; pairing with hero covers the ground under threat.

controls.notes: V-only (basic attack) is default into large enemy groups — no block drop, lower threat. X-and-V cancel (X-move → instant V) resets the attack chain but drops block each time — higher DPS but only safe when no dangerous heroes nearby. {1} Auto-fight on V while engaged is better than spamming the combo when facing overwhelming numbers. {1} Skill 2 (heal) can be animation-canceled by instant V-press after — the heal resolves regardless. {1} Symmachean Brotherhood trait governs slow, non-simultaneous attack timing (models don't swing at once), enabling the X-then-V pattern and extending engagements, but this also enables the block-drop mechanic. {2}

gaps: Origin/era not specified in Amya's source; derived from ConqHub leadership tier + tierlist context.
